description: In an era where mental health challenges among our youth are escalating at alarming rates, California's SAFETY Act—formally known as AB 1955—represents a profound and chilling overreach by the state into the sacred, constitutionally protected realm of family life and parental authority. title: The Dystopian Perils of the SAFETY Act: Protecting Children from Government Overreach
